snippet.title: TANK HAVOC Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
💥 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846960/Tank_Havoc/
💬 Join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/GJYPnjtvsF

Tank Havoc is a fast-paced team-based action game with explosive tank combat and strategic elements. 
This 2025 title features multiple modes, customize your tank, build a unique skill loadout, and adapt your tactics on the fly. Team up, flank hard, and unleash havoc in every match across dynamic arenas.

Find us on Steam and join our Discord community for the latest updates and to share feedback.

Music by Karl Casey @WhiteBatAudio 

#TankHavoc #MadMissile #pvp #indiegame #indiegames #steamgame #steam
